 Mendy and Galeno return to support Al Ahly before test against Al Shabab
 Thursday 29-10-2026 
 محمد أبو ريان 
 The return of the duo gives the coaching staff additional options ahead of the match, which Al Ahly will play away from home, aiming to secure all three points and continue competing for the top positions in the league table.
 Al Ahly are currently in fifth place with 21 points and hope to leverage the readiness of their returning players to achieve a positive result in the upcoming match.
 In contrast, Al-Shabab are preparing to host Al-Ahli as they sit in 12th place with 11 points, aiming to improve their position in the Roshn League.
 The match is significant for both teams given their differing positions in the standings, while Al Ahly enter the encounter bolstered by the return of Mendy and Galeno ahead of the upcoming test.
 Al Ahly have welcomed back Senegalese goalkeeper Edouard Mendy and Brazilian winger Galeno after their recoveries from injury, providing the team with an important boost ahead of their match against Al Shabab tomorrow, Friday, in the 12th round of the Roshn Saudi League.
